description: Iconoir is an open source (MIT) SVG icon library: 1,383 icons, 288 with solid variants (1,671 SVGs), on a 24x24 grid with a 1.5px stroke. Official packages for React, React Native, Vue, Solid and Flutter, plus a CSS stylesheet, a Figma file and a built-in Framer set.
rules: Check that an icon name exists in https://iconoir.com/icons.json before using it; do not invent names.
Icon names are kebab-case (arrow-right); components use PascalCase (ArrowRight).
Solid variants add -solid to the name (heart-solid) and Solid to the component (HeartSolid); only some icons have one.
Import icons individually by name, e.g. import { ArrowRight } from 'iconoir-react'; the packages are tree-shakable.
Use IconoirProvider to set default color, width, height and strokeWidth for every icon inside it.
Icons use currentColor, default to 1.5em and a 1.5 stroke width.
There is no Svelte or Angular package; use the SVG files from the iconoir npm package or the CSS stylesheet instead.
CSS usage: load the stylesheet and use .
